headline: President Trump signed an executive order on March 25, 2025, directing federal action on how American elections are run and protected.
what_it_does: This executive order is titled "Preserving and Protecting the Integrity of American Elections." Based on the title, it directs federal agencies to take steps related to the security and administration of US elections. No official summary was provided, so the specific rules, deadlines, and agencies involved are not described here.

who_it_affects.how: The order deals with how elections are run, which may affect voting or registration rules, but the details are not given in the source material.
States and localities run elections, so they may be asked to make changes, though the exact requirements are not described in the source material.
